name: nav-shell.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  app/nav-shell.scss — AppNav shadow stylesheet entry (adoptedStyleSheets).
//  Compiles only what lives inside the <app-nav> shadow root: the nav bar,
//  burger controls, the fullscreen menu overlay, and the language flag.
//  Keeps the document-level app.scss manifest free of shadow-only rules so
//  the critical sheet stays small, and lets this chunk travel with the
//  nav component instead of the page entry.
//  Standalone entry — imports the compile-time base chain itself.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../../base/variables';
@import '../../../base/mixins';
@import '../../../base/placeholders';
// NOTE: no _fonts import — partials @extend the %TTL_* placeholders (emitted
// on use) instead of pulling the full ~200-line class ramp; no markup inside
// this shadow uses .ttl-*/.txt-* classes directly.
// NOTE: no _structure import — :root custom properties are emitted once by
// the document app.scss and inherit into shadow roots; re-emitting them
// here would duplicate ~700 lines of tokens per shadow sheet.

$_B_NAV: 'nav';

@import 'nav';
@import 'nav-controls';
@import 'menu-overlay';
@import 'flag';
